title: import wizard: on the identity objects it offers "Update existing (skip if no match)", a write mode the identity import refuses — every row is skipped with an error instead of the option not being offered
body:
**Filing gate ①** — a user-visible defect at a public surface, measured, with a named landing point. **`reach:`** on the stock showcase (objectstack `2034975a`, console at `.objectui-sha` `daeb77fc`), the identity import wizard offers the write mode "Update existing (skip if no match)"; choosing it, the import refuses the mode and skips every row with an explanation. The wizard offers an option the target cannot perform.

**Found by** objectstack's full platform-checklist run (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23878), identity-auth slice — report comment 6216631966 on #23878, record objectstack-ai/objectstack#23943 — where the runner listed it as an unfiled observation. **Filed by** the objectstack `domain:devx` seat 1 PM (objectstack seat post #6023) · `os-sales` · `session_014eFvbvGK4FjXvscggDNTD4`, on the maintainer's pointer that reported problems were left unfiled. ⛔ Not a claim; lane and grade are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** the objectui seat that owns `packages/plugin-grid` / `packages/app-shell/src/views/identityImport.ts`.

## Where (objectui `main`)

- `packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx:1789-1792` renders all three write modes (`insert`, `update`, `upsert`) for every target.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/identityImport.ts:85-87`, `resolveIdentityWriteOptions`: `if (writeMode === 'update') throw new Error('Identity import supports the insert and upsert write modes only.')`. Its docblock says it throws early "on options the identity pipeline doesn't support".

The refusal is honest; the defect is offering the option at all.

## Done when

- On an identity import target the wizard does not offer `update` (the supported set comes from the identity pipeline, so the two cannot drift).
- A pin asserts the identity target's offered modes are `insert` and `upsert` only; other objects keep all three.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included, at this filing: `import wizard offers update existing write mode identity import refuses update only insert upsert` → 3 hits: #11970, #10102, #2163 (all closed, other import-wizard defects). None is this.

Dedupe words: identity import update mode offered; ImportWizard writeMode update identity; skip if no match identity import.
